job.source:
Job Title: AI Developer

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and implement AI models and solutions using Python and LLM APIs.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project requirements and integrate AI features into existing systems.
- Conduct data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
- Optimize AI algorithms and fine-tune models based on performance metrics and business needs.
- Document code and technical specifications to support team collaboration and future development.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Proficiency in Python programming and experience with LLM APIs.
- Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and AI application development.
- Experience with data analysis and manipulation using SQL.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with web development technologies (HTML/CSS/JavaScript).
- Experience in product development or data analysis roles.
- Knowledge of compliance and regulatory frameworks.

Additional Information:
- Candidates should demonstrate experience in AI-driven project implementation and cross-team coordination.
- Proficiency in English and Mandarin required.

Note: This position may involve occasional cross-regional collaboration within the Greater Bay Area.
